scope: N>=2 and infinity, prescribed finite disc only

items.method: Independent Cartesian Laplacian/differentiation, plus the written moment integration. The top harmonic is retained in the prescribed moment convention.
Derived from own Cartesian sine polynomials at degrees3..21, checked affine c,a dependence, every physical truncation, and independent dense determinants. General all-degree derivation in PROOF.md.
Binomial conjugation gives margin lambda at a=0 and a-coefficient row norm at most1. This proves high-degree inverse control and local finiteness for finiteN and infinity.
For integer c>=2,4^dP_d is monic integral up tosign; every noninteger rational slope avoids all exceptional sets. This uses the all-degree recurrence, not only finite tests.
P_3(2j)=Delta_j exactly. No factor2. The cubic physical matrix isB_2(2).
Independent signed Fourier assembly and direct determinants support the displayed general factorization. Structural j=1..N-2 resonances are retained and handled by smoothness and fixed moments.
Weighted complex coefficient norm is an algebra; the prescribed inverse has degree-independent velocity bound. Written contraction closes without losing radius and produces a real analytic function.
F>0 at a>=4c+20, b,e strictly negative; explicit tail bound and radius include points on the x-axis by smooth division.
Upper moments restored exactly, negative first-mode bump preserves inner inverse, geometric C_k bound implies uniform convergence of every derivative on the annulus.

Compact density has its unique sublinear parity-preserving canonical velocity. The inner strain is induced by exterior moments. Dilation preserves slope and strain but its affine limit is inadmissible.
Five rational parameter/truncation choices through density degree13; recomputed projected or full residual and Poisson independently. Not a numerical evaluation of the constructed analytic function.
N>=1 is not the supplied proof range. Its r120_polar test compared Cm-2*C8 and printed nonzero despite the allPASS summary. Correct comparison is Cm-C8. Neither issue refutes the N>=2 theorem.
The nonzero compact extension cannot satisfy transport globally. Arbitrarily large exact discs supply no admissible global limit.
